name: Bron's Quest
source:
A silly fantasy romp featuring a clueless and fourth wall-breaking protagonist, elves, orks, wizardry, bravery and idiocy. Beta available to backers. Original script by Taxcup. Features sharking, macrophilia, and much more.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/marblesyrup]Patreon[/url]]
